ReviewL.compensated_source_limit.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (E : Submodule ℂ H)
  [E.HasOrthogonalProjection] (F : ℕ → Submodule ℂ H) [∀ (n : ℕ), (F n).HasOrthogonalProjection] (k : ℕ → H →L[ℂ] H)
  (hrange : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : H), (k n) (E.starProjection x) ∈ F n)
  (herr : Tendsto (fun n => ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H - k n‖) atTop (𝓝 0)) (x : H) :
  Tendsto (fun n => (F n).starProjection (E.starProjection x)) atTop (𝓝 (E.starProjection x))
